'''Seth Albright''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[July 2001 Springfield tournament]] in July 2001 with [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|WYS]], according to Michael Sorrell's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2759">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-01-wotc-is-good-for-something-vad2759/ wotc-is-good-for-something-va], DeckTech (Michael "choker" Sorrell, 1 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-01-wotc-is-good-for-something-vad2759/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
